title: SIGILLVM DEI ÆMETH
subtitle: Mortlake by Richemond · 21 Martii 1582
provenance: the wax disc, BM 1838,1232.90.a, 23 cm · Dee's drawing, Sloane MS 3188
namesHeading: The seven Names, walked off the rim
rule: Begin at the Name's first letter. A number above a letter steps that many cells to the right, one below to the left; a letter with no number ends the Name. Aa within a Name is taken with its inward power as one a.
consumed: {used} of the forty cells are walked · {unvisited} are never visited
archangels: Zaphkiel · Zadkiel · Cumael · Raphael · Haniel · Michael · Gabriel
crossNote: Forty-eight letters, and one noted by a Cross, which maketh the forty-ninth.
ordersHeading: The Children of Light, from the star inward
orders: Filiæ Lucis · in the seven points of the star
Filii Lucis · in the star's own band
Filiæ Filiarum · on the first heptagon within
seal: “This is the Seale, whose Name is Æmeth: and it is to be made of perfect wax.”
imprint: Uriel, 10 March 1582 · the names derived from the rule on the rim
